Type: leather push-back recliner
Use: reclining, reading, watching TV; living room, den, home office
Style: traditional, classic
Materials: top-grain leather, brass nailhead trim, wood legs
Colors: dark reddish brown, antique brass
Shape: tight high back, rolled arms with nailhead outlines, cushioned seat, short tapered wood legs, compact and solid
Feel: rich, cozy, distinguished
Goes with: dark wood, plaid textiles, warm walls, library shelving; traditional dens or studies

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Traditional Nailhead Leather Recliner, 33"W, Brown
product.description: The simple, clean design of this recliner will blend with any style room. Top-grain leather on the entire chair, as well as nail head accents on the arms, add sophisticated touches. Substantial padding in the back cushion makes it extra welcoming. 32.6"W x 38.9"D x 39.7"H Top grain leather; nailhead trim; wood legs A simple style that blends with any room Plush cushioned back; push-back recliner with pop-up foot support Easy assembly in 15 minutes or less; just screw on legs Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty.
